draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.94, the 175th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 14th of 20 at RB. He went 165th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,135 rushing yards in 2023, 7th of 20 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Baltimore Ravens. 21 career games and 0 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Weak spots: team carry share 1.6% (2nd percentile), scrimmage yards 92 (10th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 running back who played: 92 scrimmage yards against a median of 422, below the norm.
